description: Provider catalog (agent-kit K1 Phase 6, server API v90): the built-in catalog of model providers (OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, xAI, Cerebras, Together, Ollama local, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), the caller's connections to them, per-model capability flags, the two opt-in switches (tool-capable chat, cross-provider fallback), and the tool-capable provider turn. Roster: all 8 method-paths below are in ALL_ENDPOINTS (extension/server.mjs), handled by extension/routes/provider-catalog.mjs, mounted by extension/routes/router.mjs, and all are token-protected and on the core feature set. A key is accepted in the connect body once, goes to the per-user vault (custom.<id>.apiKey) and is never returned. A connection dispatches as the provider id custom:<id> (id is cat-<catalog id>, plus -<slug> for the generic endpoint). Every JSON route also answers a malformed body 400 (not declared, per SCHEMA.md). Rate limits: /catalog/test and /catalog/models share llmFast, /catalog/connect, /catalog/disconnect and PUT /settings share kbWrite, /turn uses agentTurn (429 is not declared; the bucket answers it uniformly). The stream of POST /kb/providers/turn is the agent/v2 event vocabulary (init, tool_use_start, tool_args_delta, tool_result, usage, delta, result, error, approval_request, approval_resolved, notice); approvals are answered through POST /agent/v2/decision with init.sessionId. A refusal before the first event is a plain JSON error (409 PROVIDER_TOOLS_DISABLED, 404 PROVIDER_NOT_CONNECTED, 403 PROVIDER_BLOCKED when the network guard refuses the provider's address, 400 PROVIDER_NO_KEY | MODEL_LACKS_TOOLS | VALIDATION_FAILED). Not captured: a fallback switch (the notice event with kind provider_fallback) and a live provider list; both are exercised by extension/tests. Fixtures are produced by driving the real router in-process with a stand-in for fetch, because the routes reach third-party hosts.

id.description: cat-<catalog id>[-<slug>]; also the vault key stem

provider.description: The provider id dispatch uses: custom:<id>

allowPrivate.description: Loopback and private-network hosts are allowed (Ollama, a gateway on the user's own network); link-local never is

hasKey.description: A key is stored. The key itself is never returned

baseURL.description: Empty for the generic endpoint, which takes the user's own

allowPrivate.description: The entry may be connected to a private-network address (with the user's explicit opt-in unless local)

provider.description: custom:cat-... of the caller's own connection

model.description: Absent: the first tool-capable catalog model

toolsEnabled.description: Tool-capable chat on non-Anthropic models; default false

fallbackEnabled.description: Cross-provider fallback at the start of a turn; default false

toolOverrides.description: '<connection id>/<model id>' to the user's own tools yes/no

egressAutoApprove.description: false (default): fetch-url and web-search ask for approval in a provider turn, because a hostile page can steer a model into leaking through them; true restores Claude parity

toolsSource.description: Where the flag came from; unknown counts as not supported

id.description: A connection id (cat-...) or its provider string (custom:cat-...)

migration.description: Present once the one-time carry-over of the user's existing provider keys into the catalog has run (API 92). created: connections made from a key already in the vault (the old key is kept); needsReview: keys not carried over (a base URL the guard refuses, or a failed connect) with the reason; toolsEnabled: provider chat was switched on because a connection was created.

provider.description: The legacy provider: openai, google, deepseek, custom or custom:<id>.

apiKey.description: Stored in the per-user vault; omitted on a reconnect to keep the stored key

baseURL.description: Only the generic endpoint (and Ollama on another host) takes one; a hosted entry keeps its own

slug.description: 1-24 lowercase letters or digits; names a second generic endpoint

allowPrivate.description: Opt in to a loopback or private-network address

removed.description: false when the caller had no such connection

detail.description: Human-readable result; never contains the key

modelCount.description: Chat models the provider lists; present when ok

source.description: static: the catalog's own table, because there was no key or the provider could not be reached

detail.description: Why the list is static or stale

provider.description: custom:cat-... of a connection of the caller

mode.description: execute | plan | assist_plan | review need a model with tools; ask and document run without them

history.description: Prior turns, most recent 40 are used

agentContext.description: workspaceRoot bounds what the file tools may read; chatSessionId keys the chat's task list

200.x-unspecified: A server-sent stream in the agent/v2 event vocabulary (schema/agent-v2). This route emits a subset (init, tool_use_start, tool_args_delta, tool_result, usage, delta, result, error, approval_request, approval_resolved, notice), so the all-variants coverage that x-events demands would need fabricated events. Every emitted event is instead validated against the agent/v2 schema variants by extension/tests/provider-turn-wire.test.mjs.
